content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently underestimate prices in early 2024, showing persistent downward bias.", "Sentiment shifts from positive to negative correlate with sharp price drops in the following 30-day window.", "Model forecasts exhibit mean-reversion bias, especially when prices fall below historical 18-day averages.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment remains stable or slightly positive over the prior 18 days.", "Models overestimate prices during periods of strong bullish sentiment, leading to premature peaks.", "Price corrections following forecasted peaks are often more severe than model predictions suggest.", "Forecast lags are most pronounced in the first 5 days of the 30-day window, with accuracy improving later.", "Sentiment-driven volatility is better captured when models incorporate recent sentiment changes rather than static averages."]}
